label: PRIOR_DEMONSTRATION_2 requires a known premise used in the demonstration
definition: Every knowledge case has a supplied demonstration certificate and uses some premise q that the same agent knows and that is earlier in the supplied priority relation than the target p. Used-premise status, priority and knowledge are each explicit.
note: Analyst reading. The inference to ignorance separately assumes accessibility of priority. The priority order need not be temporal, and the interpretation of a demonstration certificate remains open.
